name: Clock hits zero on a glowing rank reveal
looks: The race clock hits 00:00.00 in red, freezing the final standings; a huge glowing rank word slams into the centre of the frame with a margin-of-victory line beneath it, while a scatter of small glowing marks drifts up past the frozen leaderboard like confetti.
build: Clock's final frame holds in red, no further ticking. The rank word scales in fast with a hard stop (1.3x -> 1x, no overshoot) timed to a buzzer hit; the margin line fades in 150ms after. Confetti marks are independent sprites with seeded upward drift and rotation, spawned in a burst on the buzzer.
sound: A sharp buzzer on the clock hitting zero, a bright sting under the rank word landing, a light patter under the confetti drift.
prompt: Freeze a countdown clock at zero on the final standings, then slam a huge glowing rank word into the centre of the frame with a margin-of-victory line beneath it, releasing a scatter of small glowing confetti marks drifting up past the frozen board on the buzzer.
